name: The Rescue
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called Syndicate.

We went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.

Durnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.
narrative.objectives: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!

It would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...

When we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: You must make haste, Champion. I shudder to think what the humans might be doing to Drull and Tog'thar.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 22 to 42, 18,000 XP in all.

quests.name: The Rescue
quests.objectiveText: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.

quests.name: Infiltration
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve information about Gol'dir's whereabouts for Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Gol'dir
quests.objectiveText: Free Gol'dir then return to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Blackmoore's Legacy
quests.objectiveText: Return the information gathered by Gol'dir to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
quests.objectiveText: Kill Lord Aliden Perenolde and ask his mistress, Elysa, about Taretha's pendant.

quests.name: Taretha's Gift
quests.objectiveText: Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
